answer: Each epoch auctions 64 nontransferable activation permits. A comet beacon groups applicants by shared funding and device proofs, then charges linked member k a fee of 15*k^2 POA locked for 12 epochs; the next fake adds 15*(2*k-1) POA. Five of 7 random auditors verify links and signed receipts. The gale log publishes draws; a mismatched marble proof burns every cluster fee and bars its keys for 10 epochs.
